dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0035-3d.description:

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0067-3d.description:

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0067-3d.name: Import images and denoise with median filter

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0096-3d.description:
Takes 3D ROI lists, assigns user-defined properties to the ROIs, and converts them into RGB images that draw the ROIs as colored outlines, fills, and optional labels. It can combine two ROI visualizations by using one rendered image as the reference canvas for the other.

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0107-3d.description:

Wiring: Histogram-based contrast enhancer.Output → Convert IJ3D ROI to RGB.Image.

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0141-3d.name: Summarize 3D ROI measurements by label

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0145-3d.description:

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0173-3d.description:

dag-derived-derived-mech-cluster-0323-3d.description:
Takes an image and a list of 3D ROIs, enhances contrast, applies a color map to create an RGB image, and draws the 3D ROIs as colored outlines, fills, or labels, producing a single RGB visualization image.

dag-mined-cluster-0323.description:
